en: A colorized postcard view of sailboats racing on the water in the foreground. Two large sailing yachts dominate the left and right sides, with smaller boats and a red marker buoy between them. In the background stands a large seaside resort complex with red roofs and a prominent conical-roofed tower, identified as the Coronado Hotel. The sky is lightly clouded, and printed caption text appears at the top of the image.
